subject: Dermatology visit
message: The rash came back after the antibiotics finished. Can I get a same-week appointment with dermatology, or should I just refill the cream?

subject: Blood pressure medication
message: My blood pressure tablets run out on Friday. Could the office request a refill from my pharmacy? I still have two days left.

subject: Lab report
message: My blood test was done on Monday and I cannot see the results in the portal. Could someone tell me when the results will be available?

subject: Visit invoice

subject: Need a nurse now
message: I have sudden chest pain and shortness of breath right now. Please have a nurse call me immediately.
